name: Bergenfield Summer Camp
description_short: Six week outdoor summer recreation program at Memorial Park run by the borough for Bergenfield residents only, ages 5 to 12. Kids are grouped by age with a counselor from 9 to 3 on weekdays, starting the first Monday after school ends; it closes in rain since there is no indoor space.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds. The fee covers the whole six weeks however many days a child attends. Late pickup costs $50 per half hour.
notes: Open to Bergenfield residents only, with proof of residence such as a Bergenfield school report card. $300 per child and $250 for each additional sibling, covering the full six weeks. Field trips cost extra and need a permission slip. No camp on July 4.

for_andrew: Residents only camp: recorded its one rate ($300 for the summer) and said who can enroll.

The site never says which park 'Memorial Park' is. Its parks list has Memorial Field on New Bridge Road and Veterans Memorial Park on Old Bridge Road, so I left the street out and took the ZIP from the Recreation Department's own Bergenfield address.
